attack_techniques: OS Credential Dumping: Security Account Manager (T1003.002)
attackers_goals: Adversary may attempt to extract credentials from the Windows Registry Credentials can then be used to perform lateral movement and access restricted information.
description: A sensitive registry hive was accessed from the filesystem by an uncommon actor, which is used for credentials dumping.
investigative_actions: Investigate the process that tried to access the registry hive file. Investigate the actions of the user, for which his credentials were stored in the registry hive file.
name: Uncommon sensitive filesystem registry hive access
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
